headline: Pandora Raises 2026 Outlook Following Q3 Growth
summary: Pandora lifted its full-year 2026 financial outlook after delivering strong third-quarter sales growth.
why: Global jewelry and retail brands depend heavily on consumer discretionary spending trends and retail execution across key international markets.

impacts.name: Pandora
impacts.why: Upgrading full-year guidance in tandem with strong quarterly growth directly enhances the company's valuation outlook.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An upward revision to forward-looking financial targets signals strong underlying business momentum that prompts immediate re-pricing by investors.
